notes.issue: Initial minimal Docker image lacked a C compiler required by Triton at first actual inference. Health/model-load success was insufficient.
notes.fix: Install build-essential and python3-dev in the experiment image. Validate a real request before scoring. The quality runner now stops on warmup transport/inference errors.
notes.excluded: Initial setup failure attempt is excluded from model-quality and latency comparisons, not counted as a model limitation.

notes.issue: Pulling the large vLLM image created heavy disk I/O and delayed planner initialization.
notes.fix: Wait for all image pulls/builds to complete before latency measurement; do not treat installation-contended startup as normal inference latency.

notes.issue: The lightweight host adapter needed httpx; the original HF-only environment did not include it.
notes.fix: Pin httpx in compact bootstrap and preflight adapter imports before replacing serving workers. No model-quality result was collected from the failed adapter startup.
